newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks mixed at mid-session.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks mixed at mid-session.

text.p: Taiwan share prices slowed to a mixed trading at mid-session on Thursday as investors became cautious after the index failed to rise sharply in early trade, brokers said.
With 80 minutes left, the weighted index was up 8.20 points or 0.12 percent at 6,661.85. Turnover was an active T$34.45 billion, but most of it came during the first hour of trading.

Brokers said the index hit a resistance after rising nearly 300 points in the previous six sessions. "But the sentiment is still sound, and this setback should only be temporary," said Allen Huang of National Securities. -- Kevin Chen (5080815)
